(ka)༄༅/ /'chi med rang gzungs zhes bya ba lus srung ba'i rig sngags kyi sgom bzlas bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo a mi ta bhā ya/snga dro'i tshe skyabs 'gra

tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// 'chi med rang gzungs zhes bya ba lus srung ba'i rig sngags kyi sgom bzlas bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo a mi ta bhā ya/ snga dro'i tshe skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar rang nyid tshe dpag tu med par bsgom/ de'i lus kyi dbus drang po na yar srog pa rtsa lcags kyi srog shing rdo rje rtse lnga pa lta bu zhig bsam/ de'i lte bar sems hūm̐ mthing nag gcig tu bsam/ de la sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa la sems gtad de/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ arte/ warte/ narte/ ku nat+te/ ta ke tha ke tha ra ke u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hi li/ mi li/ sab bad nya/ stsis pa/ dag ga na mo sab pa/ sam ma/ bud+dhī ṇaṃ/ sid+dhān+tu/ me man+t+ra pa dā swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci nus bzlas la/ dge ba bsngo/ tshe ring ba'i smon lam gdab bo// sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje las// btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis// ji ltar thos bzhin bris pa ste// dge bas 'chi med rgyal bar gyur// ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru// ༈ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ aṭ+ṭe/ wa ṭ+ṭe/ naṭ+ṭe/ ṭa ke tha ke tha ra ke u ru ma ṭi/ ru ru ma ṭi/ tu ru hi li/ mi li sarba dz+nyā/ stsi bi pa/ dag ga na mo sam+ba/ saṃ ma/ bud+dhā nāṃ/ sid+dhan+tu/ me man+tā pa dā swā hā/ sngags dkyus ma zur chag phyi ma legs sbyar yin gsungs so// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi gdams pa'i gsal byed yid ches sum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs// gang gi zhal lung 'chi med grub pa'i chus// bskal par 'tsho ba'i rgyal sar dbang skur mkhan// bla ma dus dgra'i mgon la phyag 'tshal nas// 'chi med rang gzungs rnam dag yi ger bstar// bya ba'i rgyud kyi rig sngags bcangs tsam gyis// skye ba dran pa'i gzi byin stong 'bar ba// yi ge lnga bcu bdun pa'i bdag nyid can// bslab kun btus par lus srung sngags su bshad// gzhan du byang gi sgra mi snyan pa yi// tshe yi rang gzungs zhes bya'i gdams pa 'dir// lo rgyus gdams pa dngos dang mjug gsum las// dang por yongs grags dgra bcom blo gros dpal// zhes byas klu sgrub phug par lo bcu gcig

/sgrub par mdzad pa'i nangs gcig tho rangs khar// paṇ+ḍi ta yi cha lugs 'chang ba zhig /byung ba de yi ngag nas nga nyid ni// nā gārdzu na zhes bya de na re// mi dkar zhig gis lam sna 'dren 'ong gis// gang tshe khyod nyid 'di ru ma sdod par// bal bod mtshams song sgrub pa gyis shig dang*// lung bstan 'ong gi gsungs nas mi snang gyur// nam zhig mi dkar gyis byung bal bod mtshams// nags khrod dben pa zhig tu khrid de der// bde bar bag phab nyin mor chab gtor 'bad// rtag tu ting nge 'dzin la mnyam gzhag pas// bde bar gshegs las lung bstan thob pa dang*// sha yi spyan gyis gling bzhi gzigs pa dang*// nam 'chi nges mkhyen chab gtor btang ba na// mi ma yin pa mang po 'du ba byung*// lan cig mi ma yin pa mang po dag /mya ngan smre sngags 'don mthong der byon nas// rgyu mtshan dris pas da ste zhag bdun nas// dgra bcom khyed ni 'grongs bar shes nas ngu*// zhes zer de bzhin ngas kyang shes mod kyi// khyed cag ngus pas phan pa mchis sam ci// 'chi bar mi 'gyur thabs shig mi ma yin// khyed cag rnams la med dam zhes gsungs par// lha 'dre gzhan rnams nged la ci yod zer// de na lha yi dge bsnyen yin zer ba// mig g.yas long dang rkang g.yon 'theng ba zhig /mi 'chi'i thabs de sgra mi snyan gling na// 'chi med rang gzungs zhes su bya ba mchis// gzungs de bgrangs pas lus la rgas pa med// 'chi med tshe lo stong phrag thub pa yod// ces zer 'o na de nyid len nus su// dris pa'i lan du dge bsnyen de na re// nga yis nus zer de la dgra bcom pas// khyod ni mig ya long dang rkang ya 'theng*// gling gzhan thag ring bgrod par mi nus sam// lus 'dis 'gro min rdzu 'phrul mthu yis so// 'o na lo gcig tshun chad lon nam gsungs// lo gcig 'gor na khyod la phan pa ci// de bas ma grongs tsam du sleb ces song*// byang gi sgra mi snyan nas blangs te byung*// dgra bcom la phul gzungs de bklags pa'i mthus// lo grangs stong thub dgra bcom 'chi med grags// de yis bal po haṃ du tsan+d+rar stsal// lo brgya lon no des kyang dar ma grags// zhes bya la gnang lo grangs gnyis brgyar thub// de la mnga' ris dpal chen rgyal ba grub// drug cur son tshe gdams pa 'di thob pas// lo brgyar lon yang lus stobs chung ma song*// de las slob dpon ye shes rgyal bas zhus// lo grangs sum brgyar thub bo de las kyang*// slob dpon shes rgyal

shes rab grags zhes pa'ang 'byung*/ gyis zhus nyis brgya'i lo// lon nas dbus kyi lha sa lan gnyis bskor// de la dz+nyā na sid+dhi de las kyang*// sangs rgyas grags kyis yon du yum bar ma// bum pa brgya skyes zho do'i maṇ+ḍal bcas// nan tan gsol ba btab gnang de nas rim// rtogs ldan rin chen bzang dang lcang lung gi /gzhon nu blo gros paṇa chen shāka mchog dang*// gzhon nu chos grub sogs las rim bzhin brgyud// tshul 'di zhu dus yon dbul dka' spyad sogs// bla ma mnyes pa'i zhal las blang bya'o// gnyis pa nyams su blang tshul tho rengs dus// skyabs gsum yon tan rjes su dran pa'i blos// gzhan don byang chub bsgrub phyir tshe bsrings nas// rgyal sras spyad pa spyod snyam 'di skad brjod// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// byang chub bar du bdag nyid skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems mchog bskyed// rang nyid pad+ma dkar po 'dab bzhi'i steng*// tha mal rang lus hūm̐ yig mthing gar gyur// de las lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa// 'od kyi rang bzhin gyur pa'i lte bar hūm̐// sngags kyi phreng ba dkar pos bskor bar gsal// tshig gzhan dag gis bar ma chad par bzla// yang na brgyud pa gong ma'i lugs ltar na// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya ba dang*// swa bhā wa sogs sngags kyis stong par bsgom// de yi ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dkar// 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la gnas pa'i// gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba'i nang*// rang nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba tshe dpag med// sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// rgyan ldan mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bar gsal// de yi lus dbus drang por srog rtsa ni// lcags kyi srog shing rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs// lte bar rang sems hūm̐ yig mthing nag mthar// sngags phreng g.yas skor yod par klog tshul bzla/

sngags ni 'di'o// na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ tad+ya thā/ iṭ+ṭe/ paṭ+ṭi/ naṭ+ṭe/ ku naṭ+ṭe/ ṭak+ke/ ṭhak+ke/ ṭha rak+ke/ u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hil+li mil+li/ sab+ba dz+nyā/ du pa dag+ga// na maḥsab+ba/ sam+ma sa mudz+dzhā nī/ sidz+dzhān+ta me man+t+ra pā dāḥswā hā/ zhes dang*/ lugs gcig la/ iṭ+ṭe/ waṭ+ṭe/ naṭ+ṭe/ ku naṭ+ṭe/ ṭa ke tha ke tha ra ke u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hi li mi li/ sarbadz+dzhā/ stsi bi sa dag+ga/ na maḥsam+ma/ sa ma bud+dhā nāṃ/ sid+dhun+tu me man+t+ra pā dāḥswā hā/ phyi ma 'di legs sbyar gyi lugs shas che bar bzhed do// zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs ci nus bzla// gsum pa de mthar dge ba bsngo ba ni// dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob gyur nas/ byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho legs spyad cing*// bstan dang sems can phan pa bsgrub par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje la sogs pas// bsngos pa 'grub pa'i bden stobs brjod par bya// gzungs sngags zab mo'i rang bzhin rno dpal dang*// rtsub mo'i reg bya 'dzin par mi byed mod// 'chi bdag chad pa'i nus pa skad cig nyid// phye mar bdar ba'i nus pa rdzogs gyur cig /ces sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi gdams pa'i gsal byed yid ches sum ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'di'i skor gyi yig cha lo rgyus yod med dang*/ zhal shes can sogs mang zhig thos kyang sngags kyi tshig la sngar nas ma dag pa'i rgyun zhugs pa phal cher yig mkhan gyis bslad pa'i rgyus stangs gcod dka' bar mchis par/ bslab btus nas 'byung ba dang sa skya lo tsā ba'i gsung bzhin ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas legs sbyar dang zur chag gi lugs kyi zhus dag so sor mdzad pa dang*/ zhwa lu lo chen gyis zhus dag mdzad pa skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas pa'i thugs la mnga' ba'i lung bcas legs par nos nas de dag gtsor bzung gi zhus bstun dang bcas te nyams su blang bde ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa ā yurbi stār bha ba tu//

༈ /'chi med rang gzungs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dgra bcom 'chi med dbang po ma ti shrī// 'chi med grub pa haṃ du tsan+d+ra che// rig sngags grub pa dar ma grags kyi zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// rten 'brel mchog brnyes dpal chen rgyal ba grub// grub mchog dam pa ye shes rgyal po'i zhabs// yon tan mchog mnga' slob dpon shes rab grags// gsol ba 'debs so= /rdo rje'i sku brnyes dz+nyā na sid+dhi che// tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes mchog bsod nams mgon// rin chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag seng ge'i mtshan// gsol ba= /rtsod dus kun mkhyen gnyis pa rin chen grub// de sras skad gnyis smra ba rin rnam pa// mkhas pa'i dbang po bkra shis rin chen zhabs// gsol ba= /snyigs dus thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga'i mtshan// mkhas shing grub brnyes dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas rin chen rje// gsol ba= /'chi med rigs 'khrungs kun dga' bsod nams dang*// smra ba'i nyi ma dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// thar 'dod yongs kyi ded dpon brang ti pa// gsol ba= /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son sgrub khang pa// brtan mkhas yon tan yongs rdzogs dpal mchog zhabs// 'brel tshad don ldan sangs rgyas phun tshogs la// gsol ba= /ting 'dzin g.yel med bsod nams dpal ldan dang*// dregs ldan gtsug gi nor bu dpal chos zhabs// gzhan don lhur mdzad rin chen mchog grub la// gsol ba= /sgrub la rab brtson 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin dang*// sdom brtson 'dus pa'i gtso bo pun+ye'i mkhan chen bsod nams dpal 'byor/ mtshan// dpal ldan lung rtogs chos kyi rgyal mtshan cher// gsol ba= /gzhan yang brgyud pa'i bka' bab tha dad pa'i// mkhas grub dam pa rnams dang rig sngags mchog /dngos su 'doms mkhas drin can bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// sgom bzlas nyams su bstar ba'i mod nyid la// bcud len grub pa ji bzhin lang tsho 'bar// rdo rje'i srog rtsa 'grub cing lus sems kyi// dwangs ma yi ge'i dbyibs su brtan par shog

/de mthus phyi nang 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa dang*// gzugs can gzugs med nyer 'tshes mi tshugs par// dri med lung las lus srung rig sngags shes// yang yang bsngags pa'i bden pa mngon gyur shog /tshe 'dir theg mchog sgrub pa mthar phyin nas// rgya tshad bkod pa byis blo'i yul min pa'i// zhing khams mchog tu tshe dpag med mgon gyi// yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas 'gyur par shog /ces pa 'di ni log 'tsho'i khur gyis non pa'i bla gzugs ngag dbang legs grub kyis ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsan yig tshigs bcad ma'i kha bskangs te/ rje bla ma kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi sku'i rim gror dmigs nas sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu bsgril nas gsol ba btab pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'chi med rang gzungs kyi sgom bzlas snying por dril ba tshe srog rdo rjer bsgrub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa kun las btus par/ 'jigs pa thams cad las srung ba'i phyir rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod las byung ba'i tshe rabs mtha' yas pa dran par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mthu che ba'i yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bdun po 'di la yang sbyar bar bya'o// zhes lus srung ba'i rig sngags thams cad kyi mchog tu gsungs shing*/ gzhan du sgra mi snyan pa'i 'chi med kyi rang gzungs zhes yongs su grags pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di la ring brgyud dang*/ nye brgyud kyi bka' srol tha dad pa dang*/ snga ma la'ang lo rgyus dang*/ sngags dang*/ dmigs pa'i khyad par cung zad mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ba las/ 'dir re zhig rang gi bla ma las thob pa'i nyams len phyogs gcig pa dag mdor bsdus su bya ba'i tshul la'ang gnyis te/ dang po tshe sgrub gtso bor byed na/ tho rangs bya kha ta'i skad ma bsgrags pa'i dus su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/

skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ rang nyid skad cig gis mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i rgyab yol can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rang 'dra ba'i tshe dpag med mtshan dpe'i gzi byin gyi dpal mchog tu 'bar ba/ rang gi spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar la lcags kyi srog pa rtsa mda' smyug tsam pa skya khol ba gcig gi nang na srog rlung dmar ljang khyug ge bas gang ba'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir gzungs sngags rnams bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer gnas pa'i dbus su rang sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing ga 'od zer 'bar ba/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med la gus 'dud dung pa zhig byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ rang gi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs bcud/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad bsdus nas phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ zhu zhing lud pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun spyi bor tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar byung*/ lus thams cad dang khyad par dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang bas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṅghā ya/ tad+ya thā/ iṭ+ṭe/ baṭ+ṭe/ naṭ+ṭe/ ku naṭ+ṭe/ ṭak+ke/ ṭhak+ke/ ṭha rak+ke/ u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hil+li mil+li/ sab+ba dz+nyā/ du padag+ga/

na maḥsab+ba/ sam+mas mudz+dzhā ni/ sidz+dzhū me man+t+ra pā dāḥswā hā/ 'di'i iṭ+ṭe man yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bdun yod/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci tsam nus pa tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bzlas pa'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// gnyis pa srung ba gtso bor byed na/ srod 'khor gyi dus skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing ga las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas lha mi'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu sogs srid zhi'i dwangs bcud thams cad spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang lus skad cig gis gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sreg par byed pa'i lte ba sbubs stong gi dbus su rang sems nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig mthing ga dri ma med pa'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phro ba'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba dkar po g.yas bskor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu gzi brjid thams cad dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can rnams kyi tshe dpal bsod nams/ bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs bcud/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzi brjid dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi sna la spyan drangs te rdo rje'i lte ba'i sa bon dang sngags phreng la thim pas/ rang gi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs/ gzi brjid dang nus stobs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub par gyur/

ces dmigs la sngags kyi phreng bar yid rtse gcig tu gtad de ci nus bzlas mthar bsngo smon sogs bya'o// rim pa gnyis po 'di dag kyang tshe sgrub dang srung ba'i dmigs pa gtso che ba tsam gyi sgo nas de ltar smos pa las/ don du gnyis ka'ang tshe sgrub kyi mchog yin pas rang gang mos shig shin tu gsang ba'i sgo nas chag med du nyams su blangs pa kho nas don 'grub cing*/ dus kyi nges pa'ang dmigs bsal ma byung na nyi ma nub kha ma gtogs nam nyams su blang yang rung bar gsungs so// yang 'di'i sgo nas 'chi ltas sogs zlog pa'i slad du bsnyen pa dmigs bsal btang bar 'dod na/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas brtsams te zhag bdun du mtshams shin tu dam par bcad la gong gi dmigs pa gnyis rang gang mos sam/ gnyis ka nyams su len na/ snga dro'i thun la tshe sgrub dang*/ phyi thun la srung ba gtso bor byas te smra ba gzhan spangs la thun bzhi sogs kyi rim pas sgom bzlas rtse gcig tu 'bad pa na/ thog mar rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ cho 'phrul cher 'gro ba byung na bar chad kyi slong yin pas ma 'jigs par bya/ de nas rmi ltas ji bzang du 'gro ste/ nyi ma shar ba dang*/ nam langs pa dang*/ me tog 'thu ba dang*/ gru dang gzings las brgal ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ ri mthon por phyin pa dang*/ mkhar gyi rtse dang*/ mchod rten gyi rtse la 'dug pa dang*/ skas dang lcags thag la 'dzegs pa dang*/ gyen la phyin pa sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma rmi na dngos grub thob pa'i ltas su shes par bya'o// de lta bu'i rgyun dang dus kyi nyams len la brtson pas lus kyi shed skye zhing khams bde/ rig pa dwangs shing dge sbyor 'phel/ mdangs dang gzi brjid che ba sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad srung zhing zhi ba dang*/ phyir zlog pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ khyad par dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi zhing 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// zhes pa'ang bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gcig tu gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pa kho nas bla ma las thos pa dang*/

yig rnying gsal byed dang bcas pa'i dgongs bcud snying por dril te sbyar ba 'dis kyang 'gro kun 'chi med grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang la 'dod rgur rtsen pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ā yur+dz+nyā na bar+dhan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
